title: Connect to the Network
description: Set up your Nostr identity and connect to relays for decentralized sync

steps.title: Network Overview
steps.description: Notention uses Nostr for decentralized identity and sync. You control your keys and data.

steps.title: Open Network Settings
steps.description: Go to Settings → Network to configure your identity

steps.title: Generate or Import Keys
steps.description: Generate new Nostr keys or import existing nsec/npub

steps.title: Add Relays
steps.description: Add at least 2 relays for redundancy (e.g., wss://relay.damus.io, wss://nos.lol)

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: Click Connect to establish relay connections

steps.title: Connected
steps.description: Verify connection status shows 'Connected' with green indicator
